properties.LABEL: Eastern Han
properties.COMM: The history of the  Eastern Han Dynasty
properties.COMM_A: Extended Han border: the first major attempt to reconquer Western Regions.
properties.COMM_B: Dougu again routed Northern Xiongnu, and reoccupied Turfan and Hami. These were the 2 gateways to the West. He established headquarters in Kucha and Turfan.
